title: No MCP path to retire a project whose only attachment root is gone (corpse projects are invisible and unremovable)
wanted_capability: An operator path to fully retire a registered project whose checkout root was deleted from disk. Today: bbox_project_unregister refuses with error.project_attachment_required because it resolves the selector through resolve_attached and requires a Catalog attachment; a path selector cannot resolve either (the path is gone); bbox_project_detach works only attachment-by-attachment and leaves the catalog project + v1 registry record behind; and bbox_project_list hides the project entirely (attached-rows projection), so the corpse is invisible on the operator surface while still real in projects.json and the catalog. Wanted: unregister/retire accepts a project_id with no active attachment (detached-state unregister), and the list surface shows registered-but-unattached projects instead of hiding them. Live case: project 6233da25 (deleted repo ~/repos/rtk), whose stale attached row poisoned every gap/knowledge store mutation daemon-wide until fadfaf5bb025 made store reloads tolerate unreadable carriers; the record remains unremovable after detach.
missing_primitive: detached-state project unregister/retire on the MCP surface
fallback_used: bbox_project_detach on the stale attachment (epoch-gated) to neutralize it; the catalog project and registry record remain as inert corpses.
evidence: commit fadfaf5bb025 (stores: tolerate unreadable repo carriers)
resolution_note: obsolete: premise does not hold. Catalog projects with no active attachment are listed by bbox_project_catalog_list (src/tools/project_catalog.rs project_catalog_list_page, since 95c33ca3), and bbox_project_list now routes catalog-mode logical discovery there. A detached project is retired by the offline `blackbox project-catalog retire` surface (retire_project in crates/bbox-indexing/src/project_catalog_admin.rs), which requires zero active attachments; catalog deletion is offline by design, and bbox_project_unregister in catalog mode is detach.
